Kevin Trudeau tells a story about the old milkman route: milk would separate on the shelf and turn sour after about 48 hours, so deliveries came two or three times a week.

One food scientist found a fix: break every molecule down to the same tiny size so there's nothing left to spoil. Shelf life jumped from two days to three weeks overnight.

Kevin Trudeau's view: that convenience has a cost - breaking the molecules down that small isn't what nature intended you to drink.
